pg_fault_cases_preserved.expectation: After approval acceptance INSERT: all rolled back
Crash after JournalHeader and line #2: header+lines absent
Allowance Consumption insert crash: no POSTED/consumption
CAS before Outbox failure: complete rollback
ACK lost after commit: same journal fetched with same ID
20 parallel calls same key: one posted journal
same key/different hash -> conflict without alteration
20 post vs close writers: period lock serial order
two invoices consuming final allowance: no overspend
duplicate/late WC decision: no false approval
Outbox down after GL COMMIT: GL retained/stale projector
Allocation line N error: all Batch rows rolled back
FX issue changed after review: block stale hash
FX snapshot correction after posting: immutable old journal
COMMITTED + verification failed: alert, no duplicate
repeat FX remeasure same period/source/hash: one adjustment
SQL UPDATE/DELETE original posted line must be denied
